summary: Pin the unauthenticated harness test to daemon startup grace so its presentation is stable when tests share a process.

replay.detail: Test fixture only; no replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: Test fixture only; no persisted format, claim or schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination changes; members can upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, API or harness behavior changes. The fixture uses the existing test-support uptime pin; production continues to read real uptime.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup work beyond the usual binary installation.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration is required for any starting version or state.

recovery.detail: Revert the test fixture change; it persists no state and requires no recovery action.
